incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1/2010, de 7 de marzo, de Sociedades de Responsabilidad Limitada (LSRL), Articles 1 to 50
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de la Sociedad
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital requirement of 3,000 EUR, to be fully subscribed and paid up upon incorporation with proof of deposit in a bank account
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The incorporator resolves to form the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada with a share capital of three thousand euros (3,000 EUR) divided into three thousand (3,000) shares of one euro (1 EUR) each. The registered office shall be located at the address specified in the articles of association in Spain. The initial board of directors and general manager are appointed with full powers to manage the company and represent it before third parties. The company is authorized to file the public deed of incorporation with the notary, register with the Registro Mercantil, obtain the NIF, and commence operations. This resolution is passed unanimously by the sole incorporator.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of association including corporate purpose, share capital details, administrators, and registered office. Ensure compliance with LSRL requirements.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amendments to correct formal defects within 10 days

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the public deed before a notary public and obtain multiple certified copies of the deed and articles.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) via official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL entities obtain NIF/CIF upon registration with Registro Mercantil Central; foreign-owned entities must complete local incorporation with notary, submit incorporation documents and fiscal domicile proof to AEAT, then apply for statutory TIN/VAT ID through online portal or in-person filing with supporting evidence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; hybrid mismatch rules apply under Spanish transposition of EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive for cross-border transactions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) with digital stamps and API integration for fiscal clearance via AEAT portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or qualifying offshore services; requires proof of actual export and non-domestic use.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Full retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT with penalties up to 100% of evaded amount plus interest; fraudulent claims may result in criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain adheres to a fully convertible Eurozone regime under EU capital and current account liberalization rules. Capital account transactions face no exchange controls for routine corporate activities. Current account convertibility is unrestricted, enabling seamless profit remittances to non-resident shareholders post-tax settlement. Dividend withholding tax (19% standard rate) applies but does not impede remittance. Enhanced due diligence required for large-scale inflows under AML directives.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident Spanish SL companies must repatriate all export proceeds within six months from shipment date or invoice issuance, whichever is later. Mandatory full conversion to euros at the official ECB reference rate with zero discounts permitted. Non-compliance triggers Banco de España reporting obligations, potential fines, and administrative sanctions. Import proceeds follow symmetric surrender timelines.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for offshore digital EMIs; Spanish corporate clients must utilize regulated banking channels. Legal constraints stem from strict AML/KYC mandates, CRS and DAC2 reporting obligations, and potential VAT/GST implications for cross-border digital treasury services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding fully permitted for Spanish SL entities via electronic signatures and qualified certificates. Directors require no physical appearance for standard KYC; video interviews mandated only for high-risk or complex ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds for capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate board resolutions, shareholder agreements, audited financial statements, tax filings, and independent source-of-funds verification letters
Notarized ownership declarations, Registro Mercantil extracts, and updated beneficial ownership registers compliant with Spanish AML law

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity contributions routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' or 'EQUITY PARTICIPATION'. Mandatory verification includes board minutes, shareholder agreements, proof of tax clearance on capital gains, and compliance with Spanish thin capitalization rules. All wires require prior tax authority notification where applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements employ SWIFT MT103 for standard wire transfers or Commercial Letters of Credit for secured payments. Use purpose codes such as 'GOODS PURCHASE' or specific trade descriptors. For refrigerated pharmaceutical logistics, additional compliance with export licensing, phytosanitary certificates, and cold-chain documentation required.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards for hedging export receivables
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for Latin American market exposures
Currency swaps for multi-currency liquidity optimization

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (Mercantile Registry) — local commercial registry / Registro Mercantil Central
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar fiscal year, shareholder approval must occur by 30 June; deposit must occur within one month thereafter, by 30 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers monetary penalties under registry fee tariffs, blocks issuance of positive registry certificates, and can lead to judicial dissolution upon third-party petition; chronic non-filing may incur an administrative fine.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after the six-month period following the tax year end; for a calendar year, by 25 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10%–20% of the tax due plus late-payment interest; administrative penalties may reach up to 50% of the assessed tax deficiency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation / Update of Ultimate Beneficial Owner Data (Titular Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil via the annual accounts filing package; data shared with SEPBLAC.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual accounts deposit; for a calendar year, by 30 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Economic-infringement penalties under Spanish AML Law 10/2010 ranging from EUR 6,000 to EUR 60,000; registry filing blocks may also be imposed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of Annual Accounting Books (Libros de Contabilidad y Libro Registro de Socios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year end; for a calendar year, by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-legalized books lose evidentiary value before courts; formal warning and a fine of up to EUR 1,200 may be imposed under the Código de Comercio.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholders' Annual General Meeting (Junta General) for approval of annual accounts and application of profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate body; minutes recorded in the statutory minute book; no external filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be convened and held within the first six months of each fiscal year; for a calendar year, by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the meeting may allow any shareholder to request judicial appointment of an auditor or dissolution; the administrator may face personal liability for not facilitating timely approval.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SL exceeds at least two of three thresholds for two consecutive years: balance sheet total above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover above EUR 8,000,000; average headcount above 50. Audits are also compulsory for public-interest entities, listed companies, and certain group subsidiaries.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable) under the Código de Comercio; IFRS-EU is permitted for consolidated groups and issuers.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO confirmation is delivered annually as part of the deposit of annual accounts, disclosing natural persons holding more than 25% of capital or control. Any shareholding transfer altering UBO must be notarized, recorded in the Libro Registro de Socios, and reflected in the next annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book
